verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is a consumer GPU. A downloadable OpenAPI-style spec applies to products that expose a web or service API, so this question does not fit discrete graphics hardware. The evidence shows no first-party service API from AMD, and probes for OpenAPI files on the ROCm docs site all returned 404. vLLM and SGLang support covers third-party serving software, not an API spec for this product, so it does not make the axis apply.
